question: Who won the ICC Champions Trophy 2025 Final?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Champions Trophy 2025: India beats New Zealand by four wickets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **India** won the **ICC Champions Trophy 2025** Final by **4 wickets** against **New Zealand**.
 
• **Player of the Tournament**: **Rachin Ravindra**.
 
• **Player of the Match** in the final: **Rohit Sharma** with a score of **76 off 83 balls**.
 
• **Most wickets in the tournament**: **Matt Henry** with **10 wickets**.
 
• **India** won its **third Champions Trophy** title most by any team.
 
• Previous wins: **2002** (joint winners with Sri Lanka) and **2013 (against England)**.
 
• **First Champions Trophy** winner: **South Africa** in 1998.
 
• The **first edition** of the tournament was hosted by **Bangladesh** in **1998** and was initially known as the **ICC KnockOut**.
 
• The **ICC Champions Trophy 2025** was hosted by **Pakistan**.
